Priya (SecOps): Postmortem published: https://docs.redwood.ai/postmortems/authz-token-validation-1802509876 — can we confirm owners for the follow-ups?
Alice C: I can take the token validation hardening work. Plan: add stricter checks + unit tests.
Priya (SecOps): Thanks Alice. Can you do ETA and link to a ticket?
Alice C: Created ticket INF-5210, ETA EOW (Fri). Will add CI job to fail on missing validation.
Ben R: I'll own permission matrix remediation (cleanup roles and least-privilege). I'll run a permissions diff by Tue.
Marco L: I'll look at audit logging gaps — retention policy + missing event types. Will propose retention + schema by next Wednesday.
SRE Oncall: For secrets rotation, ops runbook needs updates. I can do a rotation playbook + one automated rotation for service tokens. Target: 2 weeks.
Priya (SecOps): Good. Let's capture owner + acceptance criteria here. Short format please.
Alice C: INF-5210 | owner: Alice C | due: 2026-04-03 | done-criteria: token schema validation enabled in CI, no regressions on staging.
Ben R: INF-5211 | owner: Ben R | due: 2026-03-31 | done-criteria: permission audit completed, orphan roles removed, doc with mapping + rollback plan.
Marco L: INF-5212 | owner: Marco L | due: 2026-04-07 | done-criteria: audit events added, retention set to 90d, dashboards updated for missing event alerts.
SRE Oncall: INF-5213 | owner: SRE Oncall | due: 2026-04-10 | done-criteria: automated rotation job in infra repo, runbook + post-rotation checks.
Priya (SecOps): Also adding recurring items: weekly authz health digest and monthly token expiry sweep. Who can subscribe?
Alice C: I'll be on the weekly digest for first 4 weeks.
Ben R: Add me to digest too.
Marco L: Same.
incident-bot: Postmortem "AuthZ - token validation lapse" added to #incidents with summary and action items.
Priya (SecOps): Two quick risks to call out: 1) recurring pattern of stale service tokens in staging -> prod syncs; 2) permission drift after third-party deploys. We need automated detection.
SRE Oncall: For stale tokens, I'll add a daily check that emits to metrics and an alert if >5 stale tokens.
Ben R: For drift, propose an automated periodic reconcile that compares deployed RBAC vs declared. I'll draft a job.
Alice C: Small note: add unit tests to ensure token validation is covered in both fast and slow paths (KV cache hit/miss).
Priya (SecOps): Excellent. I'll update the postmortem with these owner rows and acceptance criteria. Let's reconvene in the weekly incident sync — moving this to the remediation tracker board. If anyone is blocked ping me or @security-leads. :thumbsup:
Ben R: Ack.
Marco L: Thanks, starting audit logging PR today.
Alice C: PR for validation tests incoming later today.
SRE Oncall: I'll open INF-5213 and add runbook draft.
Priya (SecOps): Closing loop — expected next check-in: 2026-03-30 10:00 PT in #incidents (short status). If any slippage, update the INF tickets.
